SIEM correlation confirms repeated targeting of WS-IT-101. No lateral movement or authentication anomalies observed.
Containment: All 10 source IPs blocked at perimeter firewall.
Eradication: Endpoint WS-IT-101 scanned for vulnerabilities and hardened per policy.
Incident resolution confirmed. No evidence of compromise found.
